title: A denied hail claim, reopened and approved in The Woodlands
shortStory: This Woodlands homeowner came to us after another contractor missed their insurance adjuster meeting and their roof claim was denied. We re-inspected, requested a reinspection, met the adjuster on-site, and documented the hail damage — which led to a full roof replacement approval. We also installed a solar-powered attic fan for ventilation, and the homeowner paid only what their policy required.
longStory:
When this homeowner in The Woodlands first contacted Northvale Roofing, they had already been through the frustration of a denied insurance claim — their previous contractor had missed the adjuster meeting, and the claim fell apart.

After completing our own inspection, we found legitimate hail damage from a recent one-inch storm and requested a reinspection. Our team met the adjuster on-site, thoroughly documented the storm damage, and secured approval for a full roof replacement.

While we were up there, we also installed a solar-powered attic fan to improve ventilation and help hold down attic temperatures through the hot Texas summers. Today the homeowner has a new roof, better energy efficiency, and the peace of mind of knowing the work was done right — having paid only what their policy required.

If you're looking for help with roof replacement, storm damage, or a denied insurance claim in The Woodlands, we're here to help.
